newsitem.title: Argentina: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Argentina, Oct 8 - Santa Fe - no vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max recommended draft 20 ft 10 ins at access channel. Diamante - no vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max recommended draft 22 ft 10 ins at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - three berthed of which 1 loading soymeal pellets, 1 soyoil, 1 maize. 6 in roads, 19 due at 9 terminals during coming week. Max recommended draft 29 ft 3 ins. Forecast indicates this will keep rising for the next week. Rosario - three vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 2 loading sbmp, 1 in roads, 7 due within next week. Max recommended draft 29 ft 3 ins, forecast to keep rising for the next week. Villa Constitucion - no vessels berthed/in roads, 2 vessels due. Max recommended draft 29 ft 3 ins, forecast to keep rising for the next week. San Nicolas - three berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 pig-iron, 1 discharging iron ore, 3 in roads, 6 due within next week. Max recommended draft 29 ft 10 ins, forecast to keep rising for the next week. San Pedro - no vessels berthed/in roads/due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Recommended draft for mitre channel (high tide) 32 ft 6 ins. Buenos Aires - 25 vessels in port, 28 due within next week. Max recommended draft 31 ft 6 ins/Fw high tide (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock Sud max recommended draft 29 ft Fw (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - two vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 vegetable oil, 2 in roads, 5 due within next week. Max draft 40 ft. Bahia Blanca - four vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 wheat, 1 sun pellets, 1 discharging urea, 4 in roads, 10 due within the next week. Draft depends on individual berth.

Brazil Oct 8 - Vitoria - seven vessels berthed of which 1 general cargo loader/discharger, 1 sugar loader, 2 wheat dischargers, 2 pig iron loaders, 1 container discharger. Tubarao 3 iron ore loaders. Praia Mole stevedores on strike since 1/10 3 steel plates loaders, 2 bulk coal dischargers portocel 1 cellulose loader. Ubu no vessels, 17 waiting in roads. Santos - 43 vessels berthed of which 8 full containers, 4 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger, 15 sugar loaders, 1 chemical products discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 5 fertiliser dischargers, 1 pellets loader, 1 salt discharger, 1 juice loader, 2 general cargo ro/ro discharger/loaders, 1 bulk sulphur discharger, 1 cotton discharger, 1 lpg discharger. 31 waiting in roads, 90 due over the next 7 days. Private terminals Cosipa 2 steel products loaders, Ultrafertil 1 bulk sulphur discharger. Rio Grande - six vessels berthed of which 3 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 full container, 1 soy loader, 1 cellulose loader. 5 waiting in roads, 20 due over next 10 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar 3 berthed, commercial quay 1 berthed, 3 waiting in roads, 4 due over next 7 days. Rio de Janeiro - five berthed of which 2 general cargo /steel products dischargers, 1 wheat discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 general cargo loader. Tecon 13 due over next 7 days. Itajai - three berthed, 2 general cargo, 1 reefer, 5 waiting in roads, 11 due over the next 7 days.

VENEZUELA, Oct 7 - Puerto Cabello - 43 vessels anchored, 13 berthed of which 5 grain, 5 general cargo, 3 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - two vessels anchored, 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Oct 8 ports working normally. Orinoco river draft 38 ft. Puerto Ordaz - one oading briquettes, 6 due. Palua - one loading iron ore. Boca Grande - two due. Mile 178 - three waiting at anchor to load/discharge. Matanzas - three oading steel products, 3 due. Venalum - one loading aluminium, 1 due. Alcasa - one discharging coke. Punta Cuchillo - one due. Puerto Cabello - 16 perating, 12 loading/discharging general cargo, 4 discharging grain, 16 due. Maracaibo - four ischarging general cargo, 2 due. Bajo Grande - two loading refined products. Buoy b.71 - one loading coal. Puerto Miranda - four loading crude el Tablazo - one loading urea. La Salina - three loading crude. Guanta - four operating of which 2 discharging salt, 2 loading general cargo, 4 due. Amuay - five anchored waiting to load, 6 loading refined products. Cardon - four anchored waiting to load, 2 loading refined products. La Guaira - five loading discharging general cargo, 1 due, 3 under repairs.
